description: Conclude a giveaway: draw the winners from the entries the activity index holds. Authenticated with an atproto service JWT minted by the author's own PDS (`aud` this AppView's `did:web`, `lxm` this NSID); the issuer must be the giveaway record's author. Idempotent: the first call stores the seed and the winners it drew, and every later call answers that same row instead of drawing again.

giveaway.description: AT-URI of the giveaway to conclude.

seed.description: The stored seed the draw was made from, so a result stays reproducible.

entries.description: How many distinct entrants the draw covered.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: No service JWT, or one that does not verify.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input body is not `{ giveaway }` naming an at-uri.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No giveaway record exists at the given AT-URI.

errors.name: NotAuthor
errors.description: The token's issuer is not the giveaway record's author.

errors.name: NotClosed
errors.description: The giveaway is still open; it cannot be drawn before its close time.
